StyleCareers is an online platform established in 2001, dedicated to connecting employers with professionals in the fashion industry. It operates as the largest fashion-only job listing site, featuring job opportunities in apparel, footwear, and related sectors. The platform offers a specialized job board that includes freelance positions, internships, and various roles across locations, including New York and remote options.

In addition to job listings, StyleCareers hosts recruiting events in major fashion hubs like New York and Los Angeles, allowing direct engagement between employers and candidates. Employers can utilize applicant tracking tools and access a resume database to streamline their hiring processes. organization.short_description:
HCLTech, formerly known as HCL Technologies, is a prominent Indian multinational IT services and consulting company founded in 1976. Initially focused on hardware, it developed one of India’s first microcomputers in 1978 and later transitioned to software services in the early 1990s. With over 224,000 employees across 60 countries, HCLTech offers a wide range of technology services and products aimed at digital transformation, engineering, cloud solutions, AI, cybersecurity, and software development.

The company provides various services, including application development, infrastructure management, and digital transformation consulting. It also specializes in engineering and R&D services, cloud solutions, and business advisory through HCL Business Consulting. HCLTech has expanded its capabilities through strategic acquisitions, including IBM’s software products division, enhancing its offerings in digital experience, automation, and security. Serving diverse industries such as banking, healthcare, and telecommunications, HCLTech focuses on enabling enterprises to innovate and modernize through advanced technology solutions.

Hays plc is a British multinational professional recruitment company based in London, operating in 33 countries worldwide. Founded in 1867, Hays has evolved from its origins in logistics to become a leading firm in recruitment and human resources, particularly after significant acquisitions in the 1980s and 1990s.

The company specializes in providing permanent, contractual, and temporary staffing solutions across various sectors, including IT, accountancy, human resources, sales, engineering, life sciences, and more. Hays also offers tailored workforce solutions such as executive search, talent management, and consultancy services to address specific hiring needs. With a diverse client base ranging from small businesses to large multinational corporations, Hays effectively supports organizations in reshaping their workforces and addressing talent shortages.
